xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4661: Phone PWA: read-only pipeline board tab at /m/pipeline

plan.title: Phone PWA: read-only pipeline board tab at /m/pipeline
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The phone shell at /m (PAN-2355) has only Needs you and Conversations tabs, so an operator on a phone cannot see which issues are in which pipeline phase. /m/pipeline currently renders the desktop app because App.tsx matches only /m and /m/, and the desktop PipelineView keeps its grouping rules module-private, so the phone cannot reuse them.
narratives.Proposal: Move the desktop grouping helpers into lib/pipeline-state.ts (plus groupPipelineIssues and firstAgentByIssueId), add a MobilePipeline list and a read-only MobileIssueSheet that read only the store EventRouter already fills, and wire a third Pipeline tab into MobileApp at the fixed path /m/pipeline with the issue sheet at /m/pipeline?issue=<id>. Prove it with Vitest component tests and a Playwright spec at 390x844 that seeds issues through the snapshot cache; document it in configuration/phone.mdx and docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new API route, server change or HTTP request for the tab or the sheet
- No drag and drop and no issue actions (no IssueActionMenu, AutoMergeToggle, start/stop/merge buttons) on the phone
- No phase filter chips, project filters, metric strip, cost or runtime columns, keyboard shortcuts or backlog lane on the phone
- No /m?tab=pipeline alias and no prefix match for /m/* in App.tsx
- No behavior change to the desktop PipelineView beyond importing the moved helpers
- No production test hook (window.__store or similar) for seeding the store
- No change to sw.js, the web manifest or push payload URLs
- No edit to Sidebar.tsx's own isClosedIssue

autoDecisions.summary: URL scheme: the tab is the fixed path /m/pipeline; the issue sheet is the query parameter ?issue=<id>.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue title and done-when name /m/pipeline. PAN-2355 D-3 forbids ids in path segments because a dotted id 404s; 'pipeline' is a fixed segment without a dot, and the id stays in the query.

autoDecisions.summary: App.tsx matches /m, /m/, /m/pipeline and /m/pipeline/ exactly, not a /m/ prefix.
autoDecisions.rationale: A prefix match would silently capture future desktop routes under /m/.

autoDecisions.summary: The phone shows the desktop's five board phases (ship, review, work, plan, ready) and hides empty phases.
autoDecisions.rationale: One definition of 'active issue' shared with the desktop; a phone screen is short and the phone has no filters that would make empty headers meaningful.

autoDecisions.summary: Needs-you mark = issueNeedsYou(derived) || hasActualPendingQuestion(first agent), rendered as an amber 8%/32% badge.
autoDecisions.rationale: Both are existing store predicates: derived attention covers blocked panes and pan ask decisions, and the agent check is what desktop uses for its INPUT badge. Amber means a human must act in the style guide.

autoDecisions.summary: The issue sheet is full screen with a Back button and lists phase, state, PR, agent, project, labels, updated time and a tracker link; it renders no action controls.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors the open-conversation pattern already in the shell; the issue says read-only with no actions, and a tracker link is navigation, not an action.

autoDecisions.summary: Playwright seeds issues through the pan-snapshot-cache-v1 localStorage entry and closes /ws/rpc.
autoDecisions.rationale: The isolated dashboard has no tracker; this exact pattern already ships in pan-4523-river-bands.spec.ts and adds no production surface.

items.title: Move pipeline grouping helpers from PipelineView into lib/pipeline-state.ts

verify_commands: cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vitest run src/lib/pipeline-state.test.ts src/components/Pipeline/PipelineView.test.tsx

narrative.Action: PRD W-1. Move PHASES (as exported PIPELINE_BOARD_PHASES), derivedForIssue, comparePipelineIssues (with private priorityRank), isClosedIssue and isOutsidePipeline verbatim from components/Pipeline/PipelineView.tsx into lib/pipeline-state.ts as exports; add firstAgentByIssueId(agents) (the body of PipelineView's agentByIssueId useMemo) and groupPipelineIssues(issues, derivedByIssueId) exactly as written in the PRD. PipelineView imports them and keeps its own filter loop; its behavior does not change. Do not touch Sidebar.tsx. Add the PRD's grouping/sort/lookup test cases to lib/pipeline-state.test.ts and list src/lib/pipeline-state.test.ts in scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position.

items.title: Given an issue with pipelineMembership {available: true, inPipeline: false}, a closed issue and a backlog-phase issue, groupPipelineIssues returns none of them in any board phase
groupPipelineIssues returns working, in-review, ready and planned issues under work, review, ship and plan, sorted by priority then newest updatedAt first
PipelineView.tsx contains no local definition of isOutsidePipeline, comparePipelineIssues or derivedForIssue, and the unchanged PipelineView.test.tsx passes
scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt contains src/lib/pipeline-state.test.ts in sorted position
Add MobilePipeline: the phase-grouped active-issue list for the phone

narrative.Action: PRD W-3. Create components/mobile/MobilePipeline.tsx exporting MobilePipeline({ onOpen }), NeedsYouMark and issueNeedsOperator(derived, agent) per D-4661-6, D-4661-7, D-4661-8, D-4661-12 and D-4661-13. It reads selectIssues, derivedIssueStateByIssueId, selectAgents and useConnectionState hasSnapshot, groups with groupPipelineIssues, renders a PhaseHeader plus a list per non-empty board phase, and each row is a min-h-11 full-width button calling onOpen(identifier). Add the export keyword to PHASE_LABELS in primitives/PhaseHeader.tsx. No fetch, useQuery or useCostStream. Write the PRD's four test cases in __tests__/MobilePipeline.test.tsx.

items.title: When hasSnapshot is false the list renders 'Loading pipeline…', and when hasSnapshot is true with no active issues it renders 'No active issues.'
Given working, in-review, ready and planned issues plus a closed one, the list renders data-phase sections in the order ship, review, work, plan and omits the closed issue and the empty ready section
The list renders 'Needs you' on a row whose derived attention is 'needs-you' and on a row whose agent has an actual pending question, and renders no mark on a plain working row
When a row is tapped, onOpen receives that issue's identifier
Add MobileIssueSheet: the read-only full-screen issue sheet

narrative.Action: PRD W-4. Create components/mobile/MobileIssueSheet.tsx exporting MobileIssueSheet({ issueId, onBack }) per D-4661-9, D-4661-10, D-4661-11 and D-4661-13: a Back button, the identifier, the title as h2, a dl with Phase, State, Needs you (only when issueNeedsOperator), Project, Pull request, Agent, Labels and Updated, and an Open in tracker link to issue.url. It finds the issue case-insensitively in issuesRaw, imports NeedsYouMark and issueNeedsOperator from ./MobilePipeline and PHASE_LABELS from ../primitives/PhaseHeader, and shows 'Loading issue…' or 'This issue is not in the pipeline.' per D-4661-8. No IssueActionMenu, AutoMergeToggle, IssuePeek, fetch or useQuery. Write the PRD's five test cases.

items.title: Given an in-review issue with PR #12 (checks green, approved), a work agent (opus, running), project Overdeck and label frontend, the sheet renders the title heading and the texts Review, in-review, '#12 · checks green · approved', 'work · opus · running', Overdeck and frontend
The sheet renders an 'Open in tracker' link whose href is the issue URL, and finds the issue when issueId differs in case
The sheet renders 'This issue is not in the pipeline.' for an unknown id when hasSnapshot is true and 'Loading issue…' when hasSnapshot is false
The sheet renders exactly one button (Back), and tapping it calls onBack
Route /m/pipeline to the phone shell and add the Pipeline tab and issue sheet

verify_commands: cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vitest run src/components/mobile/__tests__/

narrative.Action: PRD W-2. In App.tsx match /m, /m/, /m/pipeline and /m/pipeline/ exactly (D-4661-2). In MobileApp.tsx add the 'pipeline' tab and MobileRoute.issueId, make readMobileRoute(search, pathname = '/m') follow D-4661-3, replace mobileSearch with mobilePath so the pipeline tab pushes /m/pipeline and an open issue pushes /m/pipeline?issue=<id>, add the third TABS entry, compute fullScreen per D-4661-9, render MobilePipeline or MobileIssueSheet for the pipeline tab, and extend the header D-4661-3 table. Update MobileApp.test.tsx with the PRD's mocks, route cases and two navigation tests, and add the two new mobile test files to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position.

items.title: readMobileRoute('?issue=PAN.1', '/m/pipeline/') returns { tab: 'pipeline', issueId: 'PAN.1', subjectId: null, conversationId: null }, and readMobileRoute('?conversation=4', '/m/pipeline') returns the pipeline tab
When the operator taps the Pipeline tab from /m, the shell pushes /m/pipeline and marks that tab aria-current='page'
When a pipeline row is opened, the shell pushes ?issue=<id>, renders the sheet and hides the 'Phone sections' navigation; tapping Back restores /m/pipeline and the navigation
App.tsx routes /m/pipeline to MobileApp through the existing lazy import and still routes any other /m/<x> path to the desktop app
Prove /m/pipeline at 390x844 with a Playwright spec on an isolated dashboard

verify_commands: cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx playwright test tests/pan-4661-mobile-pipeline.spec.ts

narrative.Action: PRD W-5. Create src/dashboard/frontend/tests/pan-4661-mobile-pipeline.spec.ts against startIsolatedDashboard with an isolated phone browser context (390x844, touch). Seed four issues and their derivedIssueStates through the pan-snapshot-cache-v1 localStorage entry and close /ws/rpc, as pan-4523-river-bands.spec.ts does (D-4661-14); fixture timestamps come from Date.now(). Test A checks the grouped list, the Needs you mark, tap targets, scrollX and the sheet round trip; Test B checks tab navigation from /m and an unknown issue id. Both assert no /api/ request beyond the shell's existing set (see the PRD checkpoint). Use exact: true for short role names. Append the spec to the test:playwright script.

items.title: Given seeded issues, /m/pipeline renders data-phase sections in the order ship, review, work, plan, with 'Needs you' only on PAN-90002, every visible button and link at least 44x44, and window.scrollX equal to 0 at width 390
Tapping the PAN-90002 row opens /m/pipeline?issue=PAN-90002 showing its title and in-review with no tab bar, and Back returns to /m/pipeline
Opening /m and tapping Pipeline routes to /m/pipeline, and /m/pipeline?issue=PAN-99999 shows 'This issue is not in the pipeline.'
The spec records no /api/ request outside the allowed shell set, and the test:playwright script contains tests/pan-4661-mobile-pipeline.spec.ts
Document the phone pipeline tab in phone.mdx and DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md
